docs.text: If I could push the Democratic Party into Lake Michigan, I would.

It is time that Governor Whitmern stands up for Michiganders and declares all bodies of water touching Michigan to be Lake Michigan. We also need lake Ontario for security. There ate no Great Lakes, only one Lake Michigan!!!

Michigan passed a ballot measure to create our districts by independent council. Whitmer literally can’t change that. I’d have it no other way. Michigan would be blood red if a GOP got the governor seat with no districting guard rails. I like the Great Lakes not Gilead.
Between the Tigers’ collapse and Big Gretch’s capitulation to Trump, Michigan is in danger of being excluded from the Free State of the Great Lakes
more than half of the michigan democratic party and around half of every other democratic party in the great lakes region
Michigan stands in solidarity with Minnesota, our Great Lakes neighbor. ABOLISH ICE. IMPEACH MADMAN TRUMP. #GeneralStrike

but also: Michigan betrayed its relationship with Ontario, a close one with many economic and social ties, by helping to put Republicans in DC who are bullying their Great Lakes siblings across the border, and should get in this fight on the side of Ontario by yelling at their representatives
And I should say it would be negligent on the part of my governor to not be fighting in all ways for Michigan in general and to safeguard the Great Lakes in particular.

Michigan's four living former governors — two Republicans and two Democrats — are participating in a forum on civility. "Fighting had a role on the beaches of Normandy, not the beaches of Lake Michigan," Snyder says. "That's a good one," Blanchard leans over and says.

The more liberal parts of Lake County are closer to Lake Michigan, like Waukegan. Western Lake County, it's amazing there are Democrats there, let along very progressive ones. (I know that firsthand.)

Every year when we go to Wisconsin for a few weeks, we drive an hour up to Bayfield on Lake Superior each year. In 2016 we saw a lot of tRump signs. In 2020 there were a lot of Biden signs. We'll be going up later than we normally do this year, so it will be an interesting drive.
